title: cloud sandbox sessions
content:
# Run agent sessions in the cloud

A cloud session runs an agent in a managed execution environment, so you can work with it without keeping your development machine online. Start a task, send follow-up instructions, and reconnect to the existing session from {% data variables.product.prodname_vscode_shortname %}. Your code and tools run in the cloud environment rather than on the device displaying the conversation.

Cloud sessions support continuity by separating the session's execution from your current client.

{% action-card title="Try a cloud agent session" display="inline" %}
Explore your own private repository in a cloud session, then continue the same conversation from a regular terminal.

* [Start in {% data variables.product.prodname_vscode_shortname %}, continue in {% data variables.copilot.copilot_cli_short %}](/docs/agents/cloud-continuity-tutorial.md)
